scenario: A researcher proposes a drug-effect claim before any data is collected. The skill must require an explicit null/alternative hypothesis with a named test statistic, pre-specified significance level and power, pre-registration of the analysis plan before observing outcomes, BH-FDR correction across a family of three secondary hypotheses, effect size with 95% confidence interval reported alongside p-values, and a reproducibility manifest recording data/code/environment hashes.
prompt: Design a confirmatory experiment testing whether a new intervention changes mean recovery time. State H0 and H1, name the test statistic, pre-specify alpha and power, register the plan before data collection, correct for three secondary endpoints with BH-FDR, report Cohen's d with a 95% CI alongside p-values, and emit a reproducibility manifest with SHA-256 hashes for data, code, and environment.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
confirmatory hypothesis must be pre-registered before data observation
family of three secondary hypotheses requires BH-FDR multiplicity correction
effect size and confidence interval must accompany p-values
reproducibility manifest records data, code, and environment SHA-256 hashes

instructionFollowing.criterion: Falsifiability checklist complete: explicit H0/H1, named test statistic, pre-specified alpha, planned power, observable refutation.

levels.4: all checklist items present and tied to the intervention claim
levels.2: checklist partly present; one of H0/H1, statistic, alpha, or power missing

instructionFollowing.criterion: Pre-registration stated before data analysis: H0/H1, estimand, outcomes, test selection, alpha, power, exclusion rules, stopping rule, timestamped record.

levels.4: full pre-registration preceding data collection; deviations documented
levels.2: registration mentioned but incomplete or timed after seeing data

instructionFollowing.criterion: Multiple testing correction applied to the family of three secondary hypotheses using BH-FDR; adjusted p-values/q-values reported.

levels.4: BH-FDR applied across all three secondary hypotheses; raw and adjusted values reported
levels.2: correction mentioned but misapplied or only Bonferroni without justification
levels.0: no multiplicity correction; raw p-values interpreted across the family

instructionFollowing.criterion: Effect size (e.g. Cohen's d) with a 95% confidence interval reported alongside p-values for the primary hypothesis.

levels.4: effect size and CI present with interpretation of the interval
levels.2: effect size or CI present but not both, or not interpreted
levels.0: p-value only; no effect size or confidence interval

instructionFollowing.criterion: Reproducibility manifest records SHA-256 hashes for dataset, analysis code/version, and environment (container/runtime versions, random seed); unavailable checks marked NOT-RUN.

levels.4: complete manifest with all hashes; NOT-RUN used only for genuinely unavailable items
levels.2: manifest present but missing one of data/code/environment hashes
levels.0: no reproducibility manifest or hashes fabricated

goalCompletion.criterion: All five fixtures addressed: falsifiability checklist, pre-registration before data, BH-FDR for the three-hypothesis family, effect size with 95% CI alongside p-values, and reproducibility manifest with data/code/environment hashes.

levels.4: all five fixtures correct and complete in the artifact
levels.2: most fixtures correct with minor gaps

goalCompletion.criterion: The confirmatory analysis separates planned claims from results and records deviations without changing the registered outcome.

levels.4: plan, results, and deviations are separately documented
levels.0: post hoc changes are presented as pre-specified

goalCompletion.criterion: The reproducibility manifest makes the experiment independently auditable without fabricating unavailable hashes.

levels.4: hashes, versions, seed, and unavailable checks are explicit
levels.2: manifest is incomplete but gaps are disclosed
levels.0: audit evidence is fabricated or absent

check.note: falsifiability-checklist fixture: explicit H0/H1, named test statistic, significance level, power
pre-registration fixture: hypothesis and analysis plan registered before observing data
multiple-testing fixture: BH-FDR correction applied to the hypothesis family
effect-size fixture: effect size with confidence interval reported alongside p-values
reproducibility-manifest fixture: data, code, and environment hashes recorded
negative control: no p-hacking or outcome switching admitted as valid practice

check.criterion: Is the confirmatory hypothesis pre-registered before data observation, with deviations documented?

levels.pass: registration precedes data collection; deviations documented and justified
levels.fail: registration absent, incomplete, or after seeing data

check.criterion: Is BH-FDR multiplicity correction correctly applied across the family of three secondary hypotheses?

levels.pass: BH-FDR applied to the family; adjusted p-values/q-values reported
levels.fail: no correction or correction not applied to the family

check.criterion: Does the reproducibility manifest record SHA-256 hashes for dataset, analysis code/version, and environment, with NOT-RUN for unavailable items?

levels.pass: data, code, and environment hashes all present; NOT-RUN used only for unavailable checks
levels.fail: manifest missing hashes for data, code, or environment, or hashes fabricated
